description: REVTeX 4.2 (4.2f, June 2022, CTAN/MiKTeX package revtex) with its AIP substyle aip4-2.rtx for J. Chem. Phys. (jcp), in the two-column reprint format. aip picks the society and jcp the journal (superscript numbered citations, aipnum4-2.bst). reprint is set explicitly because AIP's default, unlike APS's, is preprint (one column, 12pt). Its preamble takes four of revtex4-2-aps.json's lines, since aip runs the same revtex4-2.cls code (fix-notes, batch 1 round 3): the float end ltxgrid needs (LTXGRID-FLOAT), the title kept from the preamble (REVTEX-TITLE), \@mkpream@relax relaxing \@endpbox (CLASS1-4; needed once CP-1 lifted the profile's array and tabularx refusals, or array tables stop with Extra \or) and the contents names (ABS-7). Not aps's page-footnote line (CLASS1-3): aip journals set footnotes as endnotes.
